# Fitness Program Skill for Muse

A complete pipeline where a team of four agents collaborates to produce, in one go: a goal-based program (hypertrophy, strength, weight loss…), a weekly schedule, an exercise guide with substitutions, a nutrition-pairing table, and progress-tracking templates.
